High-prevalence classes (Digital Arrest and Extortion) achieve 100% precision and recall, dominating micro-accuracy. Conversely, rare classes (e.g., Job/Lottery Fraud and Delivery Impersonation with support N < 20 in test sets) experience higher relative sensitivity to individual errors, lowering the unweighted macro-average.
